بُهْلُولٌ One that shrinks from foul things, and is generous, or noble; applied to a man (Ibn- 'Abbád, JK) and to a woman: (JK:) pl. بَهَالِيلُ. (Ibn-'Abbád, JK.) A lord, chief, or prince, combining all good qualities. (Seer, K.) ―
-b2- A great, or frequent, laugher. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
